name: GGPKG Package Viewer
summary:
Use the Garden Gnome Package Viewer to view outputs from Pano2VR using the package format (ggpkg files).

The Package Viewer supports all skin features, including pop-ups, projection changes, and videos. There is no package size limit for GGPKG files.

To transfer a package from the computer to the device, you can use any cloud drive.

To add a package using other cloud services, use the “Export… “ or “Open with...” option.
